repos.name: YizhiSong/FriesTrader
repos.description: A fully automated AI trading agent that trades real Robinhood orders via its Agentic Trading MCP under mechanical, auditable risk rules the model cannot override. Once set up, it is able to run on its own schedule, screening and trading stocks under a narrow, explicit gate. Cheap to run — Claude Pro only, no metered API spend. Not financial advice.
repos.one_liner: A fully automated AI trading agent that executes real Robinhood orders via an Agentic Trading MCP with hard-coded, immutable risk constraints.
bullets: Built in Python using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge LLM reasoning with financial execution.
Implements a 'hard-coded' risk management layer that operates independently of the AI model's decision-making.
Designed for auditable, automated trading workflows on the Robinhood platform.
Focuses on bridging the gap between agentic reasoning and secure, real-world financial transaction execution.

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance C99 implementation for running massive 2.78T parameter models on standard CPUs with minimal memory overhead.
bullets: Written in pure C99 with zero dependencies on BLAS, external frameworks, or GPU acceleration.
Optimized for extreme memory efficiency, enabling inference of massive models within 8.24 GB of RAM.
Demonstrates a breakthrough in local model deployment, bypassing the need for expensive enterprise-grade hardware.
Ideal for finance professionals needing to run proprietary or large-scale models on local, air-gapped infrastructure.
repos.img_alt: A small resident working set on top, the model itself on NVMe underneath, and a few labelled pipes between them
repos.img2_alt: Four steps from a server cluster down to an ordinary laptop, with the same output at both ends

repos.name: kvcache-ai/AgentENV
repos.description: AgentENV (AENV) is a distributed platform for running agent environments at scale.
repos.one_liner: A distributed platform designed to scale the execution of agent environments for complex, multi-step workflows.
bullets: Built in Rust to ensure high-performance, memory-safe execution of distributed agent tasks.
Provides a scalable infrastructure layer for managing the lifecycle and environment state of autonomous agents.
Addresses the 'scaling bottleneck' in agentic systems by decoupling environment execution from the core agent logic.
Useful for building robust, production-grade agentic systems that require consistent, repeatable, and isolated execution environments.
